paper: B. Kibler, J. Fatome, C. Finot, G. Millot, G. Genty, B. Wetzel, N. Akhmediev, F. Dias, J. M. Dudley, Observation of Kuznetsov-Ma soliton dynamics in optical fibre, Sci. Rep. 2, 463 (2012)
description: First experimental confirmation of the Kuznetsov-Ma (KM) soliton-on-finite-background solution of the nonlinear Schrodinger equation. The paper's SMF-28 parameters (Sec. Results/Methods) are used to reproduce the ideal KM breathing dynamics of Eq. (3)-(5) with the library GNLSE solver, and to quantify the loss-induced deviation of the paper's simulation.

derived_reference.note: Paper-stated normalization constants (Methods) and the reference values used as ground truth.
